_comment: Cernity NDR detection rule (Kibana Security), NATIVE import object. Threshold rule: fires when one detector (rule.id) produces >=5 findings against one entity (cernity.entity_id) in the interval — a repeated-findings/beaconing signal. Grouping is expressed with threshold.field (both grouping fields are ECS fields that map back to siem_pivot.schema.json). It imports directly as a Kibana Security rule (in the Fleet integration layout it lives under kibana/security_rule). Independently authored (§26): no Corelight rules/wording.
name: Cernity NDR — repeated findings for an entity
description: A single detector produced 5 or more findings against one entity within the interval, indicating repeated/beaconing activity worth pivoting to the entity timeline and evidence.
author: Cernity NDR
